title: Selected Object Footprint Editing Profile
scope: Defines the editor-side controls and validation contract for directly resizing selected object footprints.

targets.label: Visual
targets.purpose: sprite/render footprint and selected-object visual overlay

targets.label: Collision
targets.purpose: movement-blocking footprint when blocks_movement is enabled

buttons.label: X-
buttons.effect: move active target rectangle one tile left

buttons.label: X+
buttons.effect: move active target rectangle one tile right

buttons.label: Y-
buttons.effect: move active target rectangle one tile up

buttons.label: Y+
buttons.effect: move active target rectangle one tile down

buttons.label: W-
buttons.effect: shrink active target width by one tile

buttons.label: W+
buttons.effect: grow active target width by one tile

buttons.label: H-
buttons.effect: shrink active target height by one tile

buttons.label: H+
buttons.effect: grow active target height by one tile

buttons.label: Block
buttons.effect: toggle movement blocking for collision footprint

buttons.label: Fade
buttons.effect: toggle fade when player is behind object

buttons.label: Reset
buttons.effect: restore active target rectangle from ObjectKind default footprint

buttons.label: Default
buttons.effect: restore entire footprint from ObjectKind default footprint

validationBeforeCommit: anchor must remain in scene bounds
visual footprint must have at least one tile and stay within scene bounds
collision footprint may be zero-sized, but cannot be negative
blocking collision tiles cannot land outside the scene
blocking collision tiles cannot land on blocked terrain
interaction footprint may be zero-sized, but cannot be negative
interaction footprint must stay inside scene bounds when it has area
collision footprints cannot overlap other objects unless the selected object is ignored for self-editing
